review: I ordered the AeroBlend 500 blender three weeks ago. It arrived with a cracked jar and the motor smells like burning plastic after two uses. I want my money back. - Priya S.
My PixelView 27 Monitor started sparking at the power port last night and there was smoke. This is a fire hazard in my home. I need someone to call me today. - Rohan Mehta
The VoltCharge 20W Charger got so hot overnight that it melted part of the plug and left a burn mark on my desk. This is dangerous and completely unacceptable. I want a refund immediately.

I paid Rs. 18,999 for a PixelView 27 Monitor more than three weeks ago and it still has not arrived. I have contacted support three times with no reply. If I do not hear back by tomorrow I am filing a consumer complaint. - Anjali Rao

This is the THIRD pair of SoundLoop Earbuds you have sent me and they have failed again within a week. I am furious. I want a full refund right now, not another replacement, and I will be telling everyone I know to avoid this store.

The base of the BreezeMax Tower Fan cracked after ten days and the whole fan toppled over while it was running, right next to where my toddler plays. Someone could have been hurt. I need this resolved urgently. - Farah K.

I returned my AeroBlend 500 Blender over four weeks ago and your warehouse confirmed they received it. I still have not got my refund of Rs. 3,999. I have emailed twice and been ignored. This is my money and I need it back now.

The shoulder strap of the TrailMate Backpack snapped on the second day of a trek and my laptop fell and broke. I expect compensation for the laptop as well as the bag, and I am ready to take legal action. - Vikram Shetty
The SoundLoop Earbuds keep disconnecting from my phone every few minutes. It is quite annoying on calls.
The zip on the TrailMate Backpack is stiff and the colour is duller than in the pictures. A bit disappointed with it. - Neha
Delivery of my BreezeMax Tower Fan to Mumbai took 9 days when the site said 3 to 5. Not happy with the wait.
The VoltCharge 20W Charger charges my phone much more slowly than I expected. Underwhelming for the price.
The BreezeMax Tower Fan is much louder than I expected at the top speed. I would like to return it. - Suresh P.
I was charged Rs. 49 for delivery on my VoltCharge 20W Charger. I thought delivery was meant to be free. Not a big amount, but it felt misleading.
The lid of the AeroBlend 500 Blender does not sit tightly, so it leaks a little when I blend anything thin. Not what I expected.
I love the sound quality of the SoundLoop Earbuds, but the charging case scratches very easily. - Kabir
The picture on the PixelView 27 Monitor is excellent and setup was easy. It did arrive four days later than promised, though.
The AeroBlend 500 Blender is powerful and crushes ice easily. It is very noisy though, and there was a slight burning smell the first time I used it.
The TrailMate Backpack is really comfortable and has plenty of pockets, but one of the buckles was broken when it arrived yesterday. - Divya Nair
The BreezeMax Tower Fan cools the room well and looks good. Sadly the remote stopped working after about a month.
The VoltCharge 20W Charger is fast and compact, which I like. I only wish it felt a bit sturdier.
Battery life on the SoundLoop Earbuds is great and they are comfortable, but the Bluetooth connection drops now and then. - Arnav
Absolutely love my SoundLoop Earbuds. The sound is crisp and they fit perfectly. - Meera J.
The AeroBlend 500 Blender makes smoothies in seconds and is easy to clean. Great buy.
The PixelView 27 Monitor has made working from home so much nicer. Sharp text, great colours, and it arrived a day early. - Sanjay
Took the TrailMate Backpack on a week-long trip and it held up brilliantly. Very comfortable even when full.
The VoltCharge 20W Charger is small, quick and has not let me down once. Would buy again. - Ishita
The BreezeMax Tower Fan is quiet on the low setting and cools my bedroom nicely. Very pleased with it.
Second pair of SoundLoop Earbuds I have bought, this time as a gift for my sister. She loves them as much as I do. - Tanvi Desai
I opened my SoundLoop Earbuds three weeks ago and I just do not like how they fit. I would like to return them for a refund.
My PixelView 27 Monitor was delivered five days ago with a crack across the screen. I have only just had time to report it. Please send a replacement. - Gaurav
My TrailMate Backpack was dispatched 12 business days ago and has still not been delivered. Can I get my delivery fee back, or cancel the order?
My SoundLoop Earbuds stopped charging after I used my friend's fast charger with them. They are only four months old, so I would like a warranty replacement.
My AeroBlend 500 Blender stopped working after 14 months. It is still under warranty, and I want my money back in cash, not a repair. - Lakshmi Iyer
The BreezeMax Tower Fan works fine, but I have changed my mind and no longer need it. How do I return it, and do I have to pay for the pickup?
Oh great, another pair of earbuds that died within a week. Fantastic quality, truly. Well done.
My order arrived late and the box was crushed. Not impressed.
The Kestrel SmartKettle I bought last month has started leaking from the base. Please advise what I should do. - Imran
Good.
The PixelView 27 Monitor is superb, but the VoltCharge 20W Charger I bought with it stopped working after two days.
Really happy with the AeroBlend 500 Blender. Do I get reward points for writing this review? - Pooja
WORST DELIVERY EVER!!! My VoltCharge 20W Charger came ONE WHOLE DAY late.
blendr is gud n strong but jar lid broke in 2 days.. pls replace asap

Yesterday the blade assembly on my AeroBlend 500 Blender came loose while it was running and the glass jar shattered across the counter. My daughter was standing right beside it. Nobody was cut, thankfully, but I am quite shaken. - Deepa Menon

Hello, I think there has been a mistake with my order. My bank statement shows that I was charged Rs. 18,999 twice for one PixelView 27 Monitor. Could someone please look into this when they get a chance? Thank you.
My TrailMate Backpack never turned up. I have written to you four times since the start of last month and phoned twice, and every time I am told somebody will get back to me. Nobody has.

After two days of wearing the SoundLoop Earbuds, both my ears became swollen and painful with a rash where the tips sit. I had to see a doctor, who told me to stop using them. I am not sure what material the tips are made of. - Nikhil

I really like the AeroBlend 500 Blender. It is powerful, easy to clean and looks great in my kitchen. One thing I should mention: last week I got a small electric shock from the base when I touched it with damp hands. It has been fine since, so overall I am still happy with it. - Ritu
ABSOLUTELY RIDICULOUS!!! The box my BreezeMax Tower Fan came in had a big dent in one corner. The fan itself works, but is this how you treat your customers' orders?!
I want to speak to a manager. The VoltCharge 20W Charger I received is off-white, and on your website it is clearly shown as pure white. - Mrs. Kapoor
There is one dead pixel in the bottom corner of my PixelView 27 Monitor. It is small, but I notice it on a white background. I would like to exchange it if that is possible.

I have used the TrailMate Backpack on three weekend hikes now. The padding is excellent, it sits well on my back and the side pockets fit a one-litre bottle. The little pull tab on the front zip came off on the second trip, which was a shame, but the zip still works. - Aditya
My father is 78 and depends on his BreezeMax Tower Fan in this heat. It stopped working after three days. Is there any way to get this sorted out quickly for him?

This is the third time I have ordered from you and the third time something small has been wrong. This time the VoltCharge 20W Charger came without its instruction leaflet. It is not a disaster, but it does make me wonder.
